# fjordrun_domain_verification (Resource)

Waits until a custom domain is verified and active. Use it after the DNS records from `fjordrun_domain.dns_records` are created, typically by a DNS provider in the same configuration. It creates nothing on Fjordrun: destroying it does nothing, and it fails if the `create` timeout (default 30 minutes) runs out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

resource "fjordrun_service" "web" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "web"
  source         = { type = "image", image = "nginxdemos/hello:0.4" }
}

resource "fjordrun_domain" "shop" {
  service_id     = fjordrun_service.web.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_service.web.environment_id
  hostname       = "shop.example.com"
}

# In a real configuration, add depends_on with the DNS provider's records.
resource "fjordrun_domain_verification" "shop" {
  domain_id = fjordrun_domain.shop.id

  timeouts = {
    create = "1h"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The domain to verify.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The domain's hostname.
- `id` (String) The domain ID.
- `status` (String) The domain's status.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by domain ID
terraform import fjordrun_domain_verification.shop 99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999
```
